title: Fresh owned-process cleanup and unchanged memory latency/quality budgets

Retain the300ms context/500ms retrieval budget and golden retrieval/fidelity oracles; optimize actual redundant work without changing data or measured timers.

No changed benchmark thresholds/corpus or mocked latency

outputs: Truthful FAIL124 cleanup and stopped owned descendants

acceptance_criteria: Existing and private-reaping real process oracles execute/PASS without skips

A private Linux helper reaps adopted descendants before terminal cleanup; Windows executes actual owned-tree assertions without a skip.
Original held-out retrieval/fact fidelity assertions remain passing.

recovery: At most the one explicitly authorized additional correction cycle. A new failed correction stops; no counter reset or unchanged-source CI retry.
